messages:
Ava: Heads-up — I started prototyping a quota-aware sampling route. idea: OTLP spans carry a small attribute that hints quota pressure so the routing layer can bias head vs tail sampling per-tenant.
Jordan: Can you paste a tiny example of the attribute? curious how intrusive it is.
Ava: sure — thinking minimal string enum. example:
```
// span resource/attr
"sampling.quota_hint": "low"  // values: low | normal | high
```
Sam: hmm. any change to producers required? i.e. SDKs/clients must set this when they detect throttles? or we infer from tenant metadata in the router?
Ava: both options on the table. prefer producers set it when they see e.g. 429s or token burn. fallback: router can consult tenant quota usage cache and synthesize hint.
Maria: console UX question — if we expose this as a rollout toggle, how would teams opt-in? i'd rather not add a billion knobs. proposal: per-tenant policy with three preset profiles (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and a single feature flag to enable quota-aware routing.
Jordan: that sounds reasonable. operationally we need deterministic sampling for debugging — if head sampling changes determinism we could lose traces for incident repro.
Sam: agree. we should keep a small deterministic reservoir: e.g. always keep 0.1% of spans (or a fixed N per minute) regardless of sampling decision. call it `tail_preserve` or `reservoir`.
Ava: yup — implementation sketch:
```
route_decision = if quota_hint=="low" then HEAD with p=0.8 else fallback to normal pipeline
always_keep = reservoir.sample(0.001)
mark_span(attr: "sampling.decision" -> "head|tail|reservoir")
```
Maria: console needs to show estimated retention delta and cost impact before enabling. we can compute an estimated tokens/saved metric from past retention windows.
Jordan: exporters note — OTLP/Jaeger exporters must preserve attr. also important: the batcher should emit a `spans.dropped_by_sampling` counter with tenant tag so billing/alerts are accurate.
Sam: and we should avoid changing OTLP protobuf shape. prefer adding semantic attribute under `resource` or `attributes` instead of new field. less churn for downstream.
Ava: +1. also: downstream analytics team wants to run A/B test of "quota_hint via SDK" vs "router-inferred quota_hint". can we support both through a priority order?
Maria: yes, in the console rollout UI we can let users choose source: SDK, Router, or Hybrid. default = hybrid. rollout plan: 1% tenants -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% per tier.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: sampling-router-v2 -> canary on prod-az-a at 2025-03-14T16:20:00Z :rocket:
Jordan: last ops concern: tail sampling requires keeping KV cache of recent spans for potential reconstruction. that storage needs retention + quick lookup. estimate added small SSD usage per router instance.
Sam: i'll do a quick cost sketch. also adding metrics: `sampling.decisions`, `sampling.reservoir_kept`, `sampling.spans_dropped`, and `sampling.estimate_cost_savings`.
Ava: ok. next steps: Sam will draft cost & storage impact, Maria will mock console toggle and rollout UX, Jordan will write a short RFC for the router API (attribute semantics + fallback), i'll prototype the router policy and a minimal SDK flag. target sync in 3 days? :calendar:
Maria: sounds good. i'll add a mock to figma and link in the RFC.
Sam: added to my TODOs.
Jordan: i'll create RFC doc and assign reviewers (eng-platform, devex, analytics).
Ava: thanks all — leaving notes in the prototype thread. ping me for clarifications.
